limitations: Author manuscript version read; no claim to have independently compared final typeset publisher version. All main text/figures/tables read; supplemental text and three figure plates read; workbook selected cells only and movies unread.

Family9 transcript discrepancy is resolved by paired VEP rows: NM_001351425.2 R727C equals NM_001134225.2 R760C at98565765C>T. Source Table2 Likely pathogenic versus packet Pathogenic remains qualified. VEP family numbers for R727C and R216Ter do not match final pedigree numbers; identity matched by allele and case.

Family7 excluded encephalopathy/myoclonus contradict explicit individual narrative; family12 excluded myoclonus conflicts with myoclonic seizures. Many other excluded terms are simply unreported or NK. Cerebral hypoplasia in both family9 packets lacks individual source support; cerebellar hypoplasia is not equivalent.

Family7 death17months in narrative versus death2years in workbook unresolved. MainFig2 captions contain inconsistent family8 labels, family13 generation labels and family4 labels; no unlabeled MRI assigned to a mapped patient on that basis. Family12 previous Kart paper not independently reread here.

Overall30subjects17families versus detailed26subject Table1 subset: four NM_001566.2-related VUS subjects excluded from detailed main table. P/LP21 and VUS9 are not30 independently proven diagnoses; source says13P/LPfamilies plus5VUSfamilies despite17total, a counting inconsistency. Related families1/11 also limit independence.

Genotype-phenotype severity contrast is confounded by age (exon4 subgroup older), founder/related families and ascertainment. Table1 short stature7/12 versus discussion6/8 uses inconsistent denominators; no pooled causal risk estimate inferred.

Reinitiation is proposed rather than directly demonstrated in affected human protein. Predicted CTG site c163 is discussed as exon5 whereas abstract refers to exon4. Healthy adult cortex long-read RNA and coding-potential predictions establish transcripts, not their translation or residual enzyme activity. Prior mouse ectopic-deletion assays are not new human measurements.

One family9 affected fibroblast versus heterozygous mother, three repeat experiments, no isogenic correction; hundreds of cells are not independent patients. U2OS knockdown phenocopy supports a cellular role but not definitive allele pathogenicity. No phosphatase activity assay or therapeutic rescue demonstrated. Structure models do not experimentally confirm altered conformation.

Supplemental FigS3 retains INPP4A protein in patient cells; pAKT/P-S6K nonsignificant differences do not establish equivalence or exclude pathway changes in neurons. Dynasore/Pitstop are uptake assay controls, not disease treatments. Prior mouse MK801 citations do not establish human efficacy.

Workbook TableS4 other variants: family3 TPR/LMF2/SAV1 homozygous and ULK4/SPSB2/FRAS1 compound-heterozygous candidates; family13 ATP8B4/KLK10 candidates. Family5/6 Nil. No family7/9/12 rows does not prove all other causes excluded. Candidate labels are not alternate diagnoses.

Supplemental workbook S3/S4/S6 read in full as data; S1 four columns and S2 six relevant rows read, remainingS1/S2 and allS5 data unread. PDF descriptions of S2/S3/S4 use older numbering than actual workbook. Glucose4.5g/mL printed in methods is a suspected unit error not silently corrected. Raw molecular data and cited studies not independently reproduced.
